oral_examination.oral_examination: *45 Caries can be seen in the distal part, and gingival hyperplasia can be seen in the cavity. Probe (-) cold ( -) percussion ( ).

treatment_plan.notes: Avoid acidic foods within a week and avoid hot and cold stimulation. Maintain oral hygiene as directed by your doctor and rinse with mouthwash. Regular re-examination and follow-up treatment if any discomfort occurs.

source_handle: *45 Remove caries, trim the gums with electrosurgery, measure the length to 16mm, prepare the root to 2506, test the tip (0640), rinse with chlorhexidine and 0.9% sodium chloride, ultrasonic vibration of the root canal, dry and disinfect, insert calcium hydroxide, and temporarily seal.
